name: Neo4j MCP
summary: Neo4j's official MCP server (Go, stdio or HTTP) giving agents schema introspection and read or write Cypher against a Neo4j or Aura database.
description: Tools: `get-schema` (labels, relationship types, property keys), `read-cypher` (read-only queries, enforced via `EXPLAIN` and Neo4j's query-type classification), `write-cypher` (disabled when `NEO4J_MCP_READ_ONLY=true`) and `list-gds-procedures`. Install with `pip install neo4j-mcp-server` or a release binary/Docker image; configure via `NEO4J_MCP_*` env vars (the older `NEO4J_*` names are deprecated since v1.6.0). Supports HTTP transport with authentication as well as stdio; docs cover Aura setup. Latest v1.6.1. This is Neo4j's official server; the earlier Neo4j Labs servers live in `neo4j-contrib/mcp-neo4j` (MIT).

agent_access.notes: Local server; connects with Neo4j database credentials (URI, username, password). Set NEO4J_MCP_READ_ONLY=true to remove write-cypher. Commercial Neo4j/Aura terms apply when used with those products (see NOTICE.txt).
